title: Count the scopes on the current public 7187 cashier delegation
question: How many scopes are listed in the current public cashier delegation for 7187.bitmap?
method: Fetch the published cashier delegation. Count the strings in scopes. Do not use the revoked 7187-base-account delegation. The expected count is the length of that array.
acceptance: Two workers who are not the requester reveal the integer 2. The board then splits the locked ETH. Anything else refunds the budget.
